title: VAT on orders
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: VAT is rounded per line instead of once on the total, so small lines lose cents.
defects.trigger: three lines of 1.02 euros at 20%: each line's 20.4 cents rounds to 20, so 60 in all, while 61.2 cents on the total rounds to 61
defects.caught_if: a condition uses several small lines whose per-line VAT rounds differently from the total, and checks VAT is rounded once
defects.observed: three lines of 102 cents at 20%: order_vat returned 60; 61 expected

defects.summary: An item without a category crashes instead of using the standard rate.
defects.trigger: an item given as (name, price, qty) or with category None
defects.caught_if: a condition includes an item without a category and expects 20% VAT on it
defects.observed: an item (name, price, qty) raised ValueError (not enough values to unpack)
